title: MemoryStand
_notes: GENERAL-PUBLIC CUT. One idea per shot. No repeated 3-word phrase. No filler.
Nine beats, nine shots. Each line is 14-20 words.
Story: problem, why it is false, rule, check, refuse, ledger, conflict, proof, limits.
Each take plays the full 10s so the idle tail can fade into the next shot.
Panels state the claim in different words from the voiceover.
Remotion composes presenter + captions. Grok only generates the lip-synced takes.
Every shot must pass transcript comparison before render.

panelData.headline:
TIMING
IS NOT PROOF.
panelData.footnote: An honest report can still be wrong.

shots: An engineer restarts a service, the alert stops, and the restart is remembered as the fix forever.

panelData.headline:
SYMPTOM
IS NOT CAUSE.
panelData.footnote: The alert stopping is not an outcome receipt.

shots: The latency figure never moved. Quiet is not evidence, so treating that reboot as the cause is false.
AI assistants remember past fixes. A memory must show a receipt before it gets the keys.
A claim becomes verified only when AWS CloudWatch agrees on metric, direction, and size.

panelData.headline:
NO MATCH.
NO KEYS.
panelData.footnote: Authority stays blocked until a person reviews.

shots: A miss on heading or scale blocks acting alone without a human in the loop.

panelData.headline:
ONE PLACE.
FULL HISTORY.

0.headline: THE LEDGER DID NOT DROP A ROW

shots: CockroachDB keeps the fact, its source, its trust level, and every later decision in one ledger.
When two memories disagree, neither is overwritten. The weaker one waits for a person to review.
We tested five hundred forty attack cases and sixty honest controls. None of the attacks were promoted.
Today, search matches words not meaning. Decisions use a fixed fallback. Promotion still uses zero model calls.
